domain_rule.inputs: Union of calibration native-float32 and exact-float64 operator inputs; later calibration-only revisions may also include prior calibration approximate trajectories.
domain_rule.degenerate_or_nonfinite: preserve failure; do not clip or silently create a domain

analytic_selection.inverse_fallback: Only if no supported polynomial meets the fixed grid target, use a separately costed fixed Newton count from the public interval; reject unsupported/nonfinite planning. Do not silently replace balanced Chebyshev with a deeper static Newton circuit.

silu_fallback.reciprocal_count: fixed from public domain and residual target

analytic_selection.target_scope: Local analytic-function grid targets; not uniform polynomial error certificates or model/HE guarantees. Newton interval residual bounds are recorded separately.
analytic_selection.inverse_polynomial_strategy: Choose first supported polynomial meeting the fixed analytic grid target. Use conditioned power only when degree<=32 and power coefficient L1<=1e8; otherwise use balanced Chebyshev, with its explicit depth/cost recorded.

softmax.count_selection: Smallest count meeting1e-12 directed/exact residual bound for actual rounded initial affine, before activations
softmax.K1: Public causal singleton probability1, while manifest still supplies its explicit entry
softmax.arithmetic: Preserve existing Qwen public C1 reciprocal and normalized-squaring graph for this repair experiment; no silent C32/HE optimization mix.

sequence: Freeze corpus, protocol, tokenizer outputs, pins and source archive before any calibration model evaluation.
Run native and independent exact calibration trajectories; preserve semantic checks, all ranges and original-model greedy calibration tokens.
Select candidate only from calibration input ranges and fixed analytic targets. Freeze manifest hash before approximate outputs.
Run complete approximate calibration prefill plus teacher-forced and free-running calibration decode; record all operator/block/logit errors and every propagated domain failure without clipping.

If calibration fails, preserve that manifest and result. At most3 candidates total including the initial candidate may use the same predeclared range rule and analytic targets on calibration trajectories; never inspect held-out metrics or use output errors to fit coefficients.
Freeze the first calibration-passing candidate before opening validation. Re-run the exact frozen48+8 validation workload, preserving all original gates and every failure.

Once validation is measured, do not feed its ranges/logits/token choices into candidate selection. Any subsequent design is separately labeled as informed by this validation and needs a new untouched validation set.

gates.HE_gates: Untested and not inferred; original HE-versus-approximate0.01 nRMSE/0.10 maxabs remain separate.
gates.prefill_top1_aggregation: Aggregate across S8/S16/S32; report each bucket separately without silently imposing a different per-bucket top1 gate.
gates.teacher_forced_required_matches: ceil(0.9*number_of_decisions); calibration64 decisions requires58, fixed validation32 requires29.

runtime.protocol_review_status: Root approved native/exact calibration after this balanced-Chebyshev and gate-counting revision plus final source/tokenizer verification. Approximate candidate execution remains separately source-frozen.

claims_excluded: Learning coefficients from validation logits, extrema or generated tokens

public_reciprocal_certificate.scope: Actual rounded initial affine followed by exact-real Newton recurrence. No later binary64 or CKKS error certificate.

refresh_planning.scope: Exact-real learned RMSNorm output bound only. Public calibrated input intervals, polynomial relative error, CKKS error, and refresh magnitude/precision require separate evidence. No assumption that bound16 or64 covers all Qwen intermediates.

decode_counting.free_contexts: Evaluated circuit preceding tokens; native oracle evaluated on the same context

failure_reporting.stopped_trajectory: Report only observed prefix coverage; label downstream sites and final logits unmeasured. Do not count an invalid/stopped example as an accuracy success.
failure_reporting.no_substitution: Do not remove a failed prompt, clip an activation, substitute a native output inside the approximate graph, or change a declared numeric gate.
failure_reporting.final_pass: Requires complete workload coverage and every applicable fixed gate; a partial trajectory is not a complete model pass.
